name: 64Δ Core Law
laws: The board is a bounded causal system, not a game of invented options.
Human-facing complexity must remain chess-level or simpler.
Movement is permitted only by demonstrated causality.
A Pawn is an informed and honored frontline fighting leader who knowingly accepts the role.
Pawn strength and Pawn dependency are separate properties.
Pawns have finite capacity and may saturate.
Pawn activation may be programmed or discretionary within granted authority.
Assets and machines alter board state; they do not move as human actors.
External threats enter through defined interfaces.
Morale is a field condition mapped with the same seriousness as plant layout.
Every state-changing event must be traceable in time.
Identical board state and rules must produce the same set of legal actions.
Uncertainty must be represented explicitly, never as a magic move.
64Δ consumes analytical evidence such as SPC, capability, Pareto, FMEA, OTD, RMA, PM and audit data without pretending to replace their mathematics.
